item.title: 🎬$4.99 Movie Meetup: Pulp Fiction (1994) — Tue Aug 4, 6:15 PM
item.description:
Toronto Movies & Social Group - Celebrating 14 Years! # 🎬 Movie Meetup: *Pulp Fiction* (1994)
**Tuesday, August 4, 2026** Join us as we head to **Imagine Cinemas Carlton** to watch Quentin Tarantino's legendary 1994 crime classic, **Pulp Fiction**, on the big screen! **🕡 Showtime:** 6:30 PM **📍 Venue:** Imagine Cinemas Carlton, Toronto
### 👋 Meetup Details
Please meet **Nick** outside **Auditorium #1** before the movie. If you arrive just before the trailers, or would rather socialize afterwards, feel free to meet us after the film as well. Nick will be holding a **Meetup sign**, making it easy to find the group.
### 🎟 Great Value Tuesday!
Admission is **just $4.99** on Tuesdays at Imagine Cinemas Carlton, making this one of the best entertainment bargains in Toronto. The theatre also offers **Tuesday concession specials**, so you can save on popcorn, drinks, and other movie snacks.
Not sure what your schedule will look like that evening? **No problem!** You're welcome to decide

item.description: To Register, this event is Pay What You Can by Donation in support of Street Health! The schedule is below: -WORKSHOP 11AM to 12:30PM- Come explore contemporary dance with a helium-filled friend! This is a beginner level contemporary dance workshop facilitated by Rosalind Saunders that explores the spirit of play through movement with balloons. If you have something that is weighing on you that you wish to release, this is the class to do it. You can access St. Matthew’s Clubhouse using stairs or a ramp. Inflated vinyl balloons will be provided, as well as a marker with which to write. item.title: Model Mondays - Spotlight On: MAI Models — Mon Aug 10, 1:30 PM
item.description:
Microsoft Reactor Toronto At Microsoft Build, we announced a family of seven new models developed in-house at Microsoft AI. These models form a new multimodal ecosystem designed to work across a variety of real-world tasks - with models to support image, voice, transcription, coding, and reasoning.
Join us as we talk to the Microsoft AI models team about what's new in the MAI family, how this works under the hood, and what we can do to use them more effectively for building AI agents.
***
🔎 [Explore the Resources](https://github.com/microsoft/model-mondays)
📢 [Join the conversation on Discord!](https://aka.ms/model-mondays/discord)

Language Exchange Toronto - Se Habla English & Spanish **Spanish Language Conversation Toronto** is part of ***Se Habla.***
“Se Habla” is a leading online community for cultural and linguistic exchange where you can participate in enriching sessions, make new friends, and connect with a growing global network. With 9 Meetup groups across 9 cities in 6 countries, Se Habla is truly open to everyone from Alaska to Patagonia, and from Europe and Asia to Australia. Join us and don’t miss the opportunity to practice with native speakers.
**We have been meeting since June 2020 on the following days:**
* Monday * Wednesday * Friday * Saturday * Sunday
With a one-time donation, you can join the meetings as many times as you like and stay as long as you wish.

item.title: Book Launch: EAT WITH AFIA, by Afia Amoako — Tue Aug 18, 6:30 PM — Blackhurst Cultural Centre
item.description:
Join us in celebrating Afia Amoako and the launch of her new book EAT WITH AFIA: A CELEBRATION OF PLANT-BASED GHANAIAN COOKING! Afia, a local food creator and public health researcher, loves to cook and celebrate African food through culture, history and tradition. At the launch look forward to Afia sharing her story about her passion for African food and about her book, a Q&A, and an opportunity to purchase the book and have it signed by her. Of course there will be refreshments inspired by the book, so bring your appetite for stories and flavour! *Book is available for pre-order now on our webstore and will be available on-site at the event. Admission: Free.
Source: A Different Booklist

item.title: Civic Meetup #556: Lessons Learned from a Cyber Attack: Toronto Public Library’s Experience — Tue Aug 18, 7:00 PM — Online: https://link.civictech.ca/zoom / Room 330 - Myhal Centre
item.description:
Topic: Lessons Learned from a Cyber Attack: Toronto Public Library’s Experience
On October 28, 2023, Toronto Public Library shut down every network and computer system wide after discovering a cyberattack, meanwhile all 100 branches remained open anyway. This session walks through the incident response governance, the phased restoration of a 5,000+ computer environment, and the lessons TPL is willing to share so other public sector organizations don't learn them the hard way.
Speaker: Steve Till-Rogers (he/him)
Steve Till-Rogers is the Director of Digital Strategy and Chief Information Officer with the Toronto Public Library. TPL is Canada’s largest public library with 100 branches located throughout Toronto. Steve leads delivery of TPL’s Digital Strategy executing IT service modernization, innovation and enhancing digital access.
